privacy_note: Aggregated data only; approved place aliases, no raw receipts, exact addresses or trip timelines. Small groups withheld.

distance_analysis.note: Fare divided by a rounded modelled driving distance, not measured trip distance or a fare prediction.

review_note: Display and privacy review only; no new receipts imported. Legacy stop coverage, per-group dates and fare components unavailable.
monthly_note: Monthly detail is withheld unless source sample counts meet the public threshold; missing components are not zero.
